verdict.rationale: Porkbun's docs claim domain availability/pricing checks across "hundreds of TLDs" (porkbun-docs-35), confirming broad TLD coverage, but there is no evidence of per-TLD documentation of special requirements such as restricted TLDs, country-code eligibility rules, or registration prerequisites. Missing for 10: per-TLD eligibility/requirement documentation, restricted-TLD handling details, country-code-specific rules or examples.
